title: atoll disk mark --json
description: A disk's marker, Atoll/disk.toml, written again as disk add writes it, on a disk whose mount check passes, its own marker gone or never written (specs.md §10, §25). A disk missing for another reason than no-marker, readonly, failed, not in the configuration, or holding a marker of another pool, disk or filesystem, is refused: exit 1 and nothing on standard output.

state.description: What its confirmation found before: online, or missing with the reason no-marker, its own marker seen before and gone.

reason.description: no-marker when missing, null when online (specs.md §10).

marker.description: What the marker says, or is to say: this pool, this disk and its filesystem.

had_marker.description: The disk held its own marker already: nothing to write, and exit 0.

written.description: Whether the marker was written: false with --dry-run, without --yes, which exits with 3, or when the disk held it already.

warnings.description: catalog-not-updated, daemon-not-told: the marker is written, or was there, and that step left undone, each once, with exit 4.
